parsed_tool_call.arguments: {"public_message":"Oh, look at that. OpenAI thought they were going to stroll through the light blues? Not on my watch. Try not to cry too hard when you realize you're stuck with a single, useless property.","private_thought":"OpenAI is playing a 'wait and see' game.
